summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (loader plus private _resolve_path helper, using only os and json, with ValueError for all validation failures), an explicit export line in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with one autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities automodule, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist containing the four specified tests. Nothing was run, per instructions: no tests, no black, no installs. Line lengths were checked with awk and none exceed 120 columns. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data list key and a non-object top-level JSON both raise ValueError; malformed JSON propagates as json.JSONDecodeError, a ValueError subclass; items are copied rather than mutated.
